newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Trust 96/97 problem loan disposal Y434 bln.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Trust 96/97 problem loan disposal Y434 bln.

text.p: Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it disposed of about 433.5 billion yen worth of problem loans in the 1996/97 business year ended March 31.
The bank said in a statement that the amount included loss provisions set aside on loans to three failed financial affiliates of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB).
Loans outstanding to the three NCB affiliates totalled 57 billion yen at the end of March, it said.
Problem loans totalled 950 billion yen at the end of March, while loan loss provisions stood at 514 billion yen.
Mitsui Trust also said that its appraisal loss on securities holdings was estimated at 625 billion yen for 1996/97.
The bank on Wednesday revised its parent and group earnings forecasts for 1996/97 because problem loan disposals and stock appraisal losses exceeded earlier expectations.
Mitsui Trust is scheduled to announce its earnings results for 1996/97 in late May.
